phase: P16.45 Task 3 (supersedes the P16.44 summary-only noise-lanes.json)
subject: global_arith instruction bimodality — seed-causal evidence

provenance.source_head: 8641a34 + P16.45 working tree (harness + gate fix; no VM runtime changes)
provenance.seed_harness_sha256_16: rebuilt per-run; build cmd: zig build seed-harness (ReleaseFast, tools/perf/seed_harness.zig via Vm.initWithSeed — a DIAGNOSTIC harness, NOT a production CLI mode)
provenance.host_method: taskset -c 0, perf stat -e instructions:u,cycles:u, one process per seed (one process == one deterministic seed)

workload: g_acc = 0; for i=1,50000000 do g_acc = g_acc + i end (the exact microbench global_arith shape: GETTABUP+SETTABUP on _ENV per iteration)

raw_runs.note_puc: PUC itself is ALSO bimodal (10.40G vs 9.50G, +9.5%) across processes — the same class of per-process data-dependent variation exists in the reference implementation.

conclusion.causal_chain_proven: seed -> interned-string hash placement in the string intern table -> 'g_acc' lookup chain work per GETTABUP/SETTABUP -> per-iteration instruction count
conclusion.determinism: Same seed reproduces the same mode to within ~120 instructions on 12-14G (perf-stat noise); the mode is a pure function of the seed.
conclusion.what_this_does_NOT_prove: The exact 28-instruction mechanism (which specific chain-length branch) is not attributed instruction-by-instruction; the correlation is at the mode level.
conclusion.implication_for_the_gate: Per-process random seeding means ANY wall/instruction comparison of global_arith across processes samples one of two modes. The fail-safe gate (P16.45) therefore reports the NOISE? diagnostic but preserves threshold verdicts; baseline refreshes must record medians of multi-run sessions (mode blend), never a single-mode sample.
